= public

Static assets served at the root of the application by Vite.
Files here are copied verbatim to `dist/` at build time and are not processed by the bundler.

== Contents

`tbox.ttl`::
SHACL TBox (Turtle format) downloaded from datashapes.org.
Used at runtime by the validation layer to look up type definitions and generate SHACL shapes.
*Do not edit by hand*, regenerate with:
+
----
node scripts/extract-tbox.mjs
----

`vocab/solid-drive-catalog.ttl`::
This project's own vocabulary: `StorageObject`, `Folder`, `File`, and `hasParent` describe a catalog's folder structure; `deletedAt` marks a soft-deleted entry, not yet written by this app.
Writing and editing are done manually; there is no automated generation.
Identified by the `https://purl.org/solid-drive/catalog#` PURL, which is meant to redirect here once registered.
